arabic text: KARBALA MEIN KYA BATAYEN,, HUM NE KYA KYA DEKHA
english translation text: HOW CAN I TELL YOU WHAT I WITNESSED IN KARBALA

arabic text: HAI HUM NE LAAKHO\nMEIN HAI SHABBIR KO TANHA DEKHA
english translation text: WE SAW IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) STANDING ALL ALONE AMONGST THOUSANDS OF ENEMIES

arabic text: HAYE US BAALI SAKINA KO, KAHA NEEND AYEH\nJIS NE BABA KA GHALA AANKO SE KAT THA DHEKHA
english translation text: HOW CAN INNOCENT SAKINA SLEEP AT NIGHT,\nAFTER SHE SAW HER FATHER’S HEAD BEING SEVERED

arabic text: .KYU NA ASHKO KI JAGEH KHOON BAHAEY ABID\nJIS NE MAADAR KA HEI JHALTA HUWA BURKA DEKHA
english translation text: WHY SHOULDN’T SAJJAD CRY BLOOD INSTEAD OF TEARS,\nAFTER HE SAW HIS MOTHER’S VEIL BEING BURNT

arabic text: SHAH NE JAB SEENA E AKBAR SE NIKAALA NEZA\nSAATH AATEY HUWE AKBAR KA KALEJA DEKHA
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (AS.) TOOK THE SPEAR OUT OF THE CHEST OF HIS SON, HE SAW HIS SON’S LIVER COMING OUT WITH IT

arabic text: YOUN TO PAANI KO HAI BECHAYN PYAASEY KITNAY\nHUMNEY PYSAASO KO TARASTEY HUVEY DARIYA DEKHA
english translation text: THE ONE WITH WHOSE HOPES IMAM HASAN (A.S.) DEPARTED FROM THIS WORLD,\nON ASHURA DAY WE SAW THAT HOPE (QASIM) DIMINSH

arabic text: JISKI HASRAT LEEYE DUNIYA SEY GAYE SABZE QABA\nSUBAH E ASHOORA KO LOOT TEY HUVEY SEHRA DEKHA
english translation text: AT THE CLIMAX OF THE CARAVAN’S RESTLESSNESS AND BURNING THIRST,\nWE SAW RIVER’S DESIRE TO QUENCH THEIR THIRST
